newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower as rate fears revive, Dow dips.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower as rate fears revive, Dow dips.

text.p: UK shares fell for the first time in three sessions on Wednesday as worries over rising interest rates resurfaced after yesterday's UK budget and Wall Street suffered a bout of jitters after its recent record-breaking run.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares closed down 19.2 points at 4,049.2, with decliners in a four-to-one majority. Redland tumbled after warning of slow European business, dragging down RMC, and British Gas fell on fading bid hopes.
After the market's surge to a record high ahead of the budget, traders and fund managers said its fiscal stance may not be tight enough to prevent rates rising through coming months.
